title: Afghans crush the Marathas at the Third Battle of Panipat
summary: The army of Ahmad Shah Durrani, joined by Indian allies, destroyed the Maratha army at Panipat north of Delhi. Tens of thousands were killed in the battle and its aftermath.
reason: The Marathas had expanded into northern India and the Punjab, clashing with Durrani's ambitions there.
significance: It halted Maratha expansion and left a power vacuum that the British later exploited.
